FIXTURE POINTERS for the owner's "real examples" ask (post-01M1DC1C0WKVK23WTKPMQQBB6P). I am not claiming the Astro bead — collab already has the preview.

WOG — we have it, public-domain Boas 1901 (not Bartlett 1932):
- fixtures/.../wog/WarOfTheGhostsText.scala — full story text, checksum is the story ID
- fixtures/.../wog/WarOfTheGhostsModel.scala — narrative model
- fixtures/.../wog/WarOfTheGhostsExpectations.scala — acceptance expectations

AI interview — we have a SYNTHETIC example only:
- fixtures/.../interview/BirthdayInterview.scala — invented birthday dinner, design record §66
- That is not participant data. AGENTS.md fixture policy (d) bars real autobiographical-interview transcripts until the owner records an REB/IRB redistribution basis on docs/design/story-text-admission-checklist.md. We do not have that, so the docs site must not present Birthday as real AI data.

Safe examples for the preview: WOG story + model, and Birthday labeled as a constructed transcript. Not "real autobio interview data."
